Rewards

EGLD Rewards Live

If you received a reward token, you are eligible to claim EGLD based on the formula:

[EGLD reward] = [Current EGLD holdings] * [ (EGLD Staked / Users Staking) * 775 ] * [Delegate Factor] * [Stake Factor]
Claim EGLD
Learn more

EGLD Staked

17.51M (66%)

Users Staking

135k

Average APR

~7.66%

Secured by EGLD

In return for securing the MultiversX blockchain, transaction fees and staking rewards are distributed to validators and EGLD delegators.

Earn Rewards

EGLD and token transfers generate transaction fees for validators and delegators.

Issuance of new tokens complement fees in the bootstrapping phase.

Minimum required

1 EGLD
You can delegate as little as 1 EGLD to one of the 100+ staking providers in the network.

Average APR

~7.68%
The reward rate is variable and calculated by tracking the total rewards per epoch and the current total number of staked tokens in the network.

Unstake Period

10 days
MultiversX has an unstake period of 10 days. During this time, you cannot withdraw the unstaked EGLD or use them in any way.

Vote for the future of MultiversX

Staking EGLD grants you the right to vote on proposals and decide the future of the MultiversX blockchain.

Join other stakeholders who vote, discuss, and govern MultiversX on the MultiversX Agora ↗
